top_signals.title: Italy Accuses EU Nations of Neglecting Red Sea Security
top_signals.summary: European nations have taken no concrete steps to strengthen shipping protection in the Red Sea, Italy's defence minister said on Tuesday, adding that governments have failed to respond to his calls to bolster the bloc's naval mission in the area.In September…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Want to Rent an Internet Address at the White House?
top_signals.summary: Several staffers at the White House are using computers or mobile devices equipped with residential proxy services that render their internet address available for others to rent, security experts warned today. One of the proxy services is a Russian company whose founder's web hosting business was ground zero for cyberattacks against election systems in Arizona and Illinois in 2016.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Luxury Watch Platform Subdial Raises $20 Million for Its US Push
top_signals.summary: Luxury watch-trading platform Subdial is raising $20 million to accelerate its US expansion as it bets on growing demand in the world’s largest secondary market for timepieces, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Initia confirms second exploit in 3 weeks, $3.27M stolen in latest attack
top_signals.summary: Initia said an attacker exploited compromised cloud credentials to move $3.27 million in crypto assets, with about $2.16 million remaining frozen on its halted network.
